title: Real Estate Video Tour | 120 Edgemere Ave, Greenwood Lake, NY 10925 | Orange County, NY
description:
Full Media Presentation: http://hometours.hometourvision.com/7583

As a retreat less than an hour from the hustle and bustle of Manhattan, this spacious open floor plan home with vaulted ceilings and floor to ceiling windows provides the ultimate in privacy along with spectacular views of Greenwood Lake and the surrounding mountains. Following its 1/8th mile winding driveway which rises from the lake this home sits atop 14.3 acres of prime land. This two floor home boasts five and 1/2 bathrooms complete with hot tubs, sauna, steam unit and many other features. As you enter the front door, the great room features hardwood flooring, a central fireplace and floor to ceiling windows. From the sleek modern kitchen views of the lake are unforgettable. It is a must see.
author: HomeTourVision
